# Tint Haus Customs (unofficial concept page by Kerblabs)

> Vehicle protection shop in Davie, Florida: window tint, paint protection film, ceramic coating and vinyl wraps. Tagline on the shop's site: "#1 Vehicle Protection in South Florida".

Source of facts: tinthauscustoms.com and public listings. This is a design concept, not the shop's official site.

## Services
- Window tint (XPEL ceramic)
- Paint protection film (XPEL), XPEL certified installers
- Ceramic coating (FUSION PLUS)
- Vinyl wrap and graphics (3M 2080, PRIME films)
- Residential and commercial window tint, architectural vinyl wrap
- Paint correction, hand car wash

## Contact
- Address: 5150 SW 48th Way #608, Davie, FL 33314
- Phone: (954) 805-5291
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9 AM-6 PM; Saturdays by appointment
- Official site: https://tinthauscustoms.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tinthauscustoms
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TintHausCustoms
- Principal (per Kerblabs research): Benton Launerts

## Reputation
- Site states over 300 five-star Google reviews.
